sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: 8WML supplies finite continuation-list covers, injectivity of path lists, the path count and finite-cylinder probability bound. These facts do not need ambient countability or off-host zero probabilities; the explanation distinguishes that scope from subsequent whole-cluster claims. Local finiteness gives finite bounded-walk balls and simple paths of every finite length in an infinite cluster. The source proves root and simultaneous nonpercolation using these facts, countable host containment and either natural or real degree subtraction. YP44 additionally sums path bounds for susceptibility; that conclusion is not an exported theorem of this source. The lattice source takes its degree bound as an input. Degree-zero and degree-one endpoint cases are included.
